title: Isaac 뷰어 · ${task}
label: Isaac 정책 보기
detail: 가장 최근 체크포인트를 환경 4개로 잠깐 돌려 봅니다.
run:
docker start isaac-lab-base
docker exec isaac-lab-base bash -lc 'cd /workspace/isaaclab && export LD_PRELOAD=$LD_PRELOAD:/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libgomp.so.1 && checkpoint="$(ls -t logs/rsl_rl/so101_lift/*/*.pt | head -1)" && test -n "$checkpoint" && ./isaaclab.sh -p scripts/reinforcement_learning/rsl_rl/play.py --task=${task} --num_envs 4 --checkpoint "$checkpoint"'
